title: Calloway Limited Home Warranty Walkthrough Windows
content:
Each walkthrough type of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is held once per home, within these windows.

- **Sixty-day walkthrough.** Held where the program includes it, no earlier than the program's sixty-day opening days after the coverage start date.
- **Eleven-month walkthrough.** The eleven-month walkthrough is held where the program includes it and only when at least the program's eleven-month opening days, in calendar days, have passed since the coverage start date. Counting starts the day after the coverage start date and the last counted day qualifies. It must also be held on or before the workmanship end date of a twelve-month workmanship program, and items noted at it are filed as claim items on that date.
- **Twenty-three-month walkthrough.** Held where the program includes it, no earlier than the program's twenty-three-month opening days after the coverage start date.
- **First-year HVAC seasonal check.** Held once where the program includes it.

The eleven-month window is checked against the coverage record of the home, from its coverage start date, before the walkthrough is held.

## Eleven-month window, hypothetical dates

Coverage start date 1 March 2024; opening days 300; twelve-month workmanship program, so the workmanship end date is 28 February 2025.

| Walkthrough date | Calendar days passed since the coverage start date | Held on or before the workmanship end date | May be held |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25 December 2024 | 299 | Yes | No: fewer than 300 days |
| 26 December 2024 | 300 | Yes | Yes: the last counted day qualifies |
| 28 February 2025 | 364 | Yes | Yes |
| 1 March 2025 | 365 | No | No: after the workmanship end date |

**Basis Q&A.**
- *Can a home have two eleven-month walkthroughs?* No; each walkthrough type is held once per home.
- *What happens to items noted at the eleven-month walkthrough?* They are filed as claim items on the walkthrough date.
